info.name: ILA BusinessStudio API
info.description:
Postman API Collection for ILA BusinessStudio & StudioCore backend endpoints.

Includes:
- Strategic AI Executive Consultant (Gemini 2.5 Flash)
- Corporate Expansion Application & Lead Ingestion
- German GmbH Setup Package Tiers
- Admin JWT Authentication

Base URL default: http://127.0.0.1:8000

item.name: 0. Authentication
item.description: Obtain JWT token to authenticate admin requests (listing applications).

exec: console.log('access_token automatically saved to collection variables.');

request.description: Authenticates user and returns access/refresh JWT tokens. Stores access_token in collection variable.

item.name: 1. AI Strategy Assistant (Gemini)
item.description: Interactive corporate advisory endpoints powered by Google Gemini 2.0 Flash.

request.description: Sends a strategic advisory prompt to the Gemini consultant. Returns tailored strategic guidance.
Allows multi-turn conversational context to be passed to the Gemini advisor.

item.name: 2. Applications (Eligibility Assessment)
item.description: Endpoints to submit customer assessments and manage incoming leads.

body.raw:
{
  "full_name": "Vikramaditya Sharma",
  "email": "vikram@zenithventures.in",
  "business_name": "Zenith Ventures Global",
  "industry": "Enterprise SaaS & AI",
  "package_option": "standard",
  "notes": "Planning European subsidiary incorporation for Q3 fiscal year with cross-border banking."
}

request.description: Public endpoint: Submits a new business studio eligibility assessment and application.
Admin endpoint: Retrieves list of all submitted applications and customer leads.
Admin endpoint: Retrieves single application detail by ID.

item.name: 3. Package Tiers (Pricing & Setup Options)
item.description: Public read-only endpoints providing corporate package tier specifications.

request.description: Retrieves active package tiers, pricing, share capital requirements, and feature inclusions.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific package tier (e.g. 'standard').
